dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: I'm not sure how I did it, but hey, at least we've made a lot of progress, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ohh, I mean the wisdom of the ancients!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: I've dug up a lot of treasures ever since I partnered up with this young lady from Sumeru. We're finding more and more useful tools.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen a storage device that can compress phlogiston with three times the usual efficiency? With it equipped, my Saurian can run as fast as the wind!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: We haven't yet figured out how it works, but man, it feels great to use. Miss Tahmures has said that we don't have to get to the bottom of everything — that sometimes, science will work just like magic.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Still, at this rate, perhaps I'll even become strong enough to sign up for the Pilgrimage...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ah well, the contract still takes priority, so I'd better finish the tasks that Miss Tahmures gave me first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Congratulations.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Haha, thank you, thank you... Even though I still have no idea what's going on, hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ohh, I mean the wisdom of the ancients!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: I've dug up a lot of treasures ever since I partnered up with this young lady from Sumeru. We're finding more and more useful tools.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen a storage device that can compress phlogiston with three times the usual efficiency? With it equipped, my Saurian runs as fast as the wind, making chasing after monsters and carrying materials an absolute walk in the park!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: We haven't yet figured out how it works, but man it feels great to use. Miss Tahmures has said that we don't have to get to the bottom of everything — that sometimes, science works just like magic.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Later, my Saurian and I even made several trips to the other tribes to deliver supplies, so we weren't around here as often... *sigh* This is all thanks to Miss Tahmures's help. I sure hope I'm not slowing her research down in any way.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Huh? I won? Wow, I'll take it, even though I've got no idea how I came out on top, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: *sigh* I lost, just as expected...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Thank you. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: I'd love to have found more useful treasure, but our present gains will fuel my research for a time.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, Ms. Tahmures said that we shouldn't make too much of a fuss when the Akademiya folks show up, since we did leave early without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Seems like research and tournaments both favor those who are prepared to start at any time.
